title: clethra ferruginea
intro: Clethra ferruginea, commonly known as the rusty ninebark, is a species of flowering plant in the family Clethraceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties that can aid in soothing skin irritations and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Clethra ferruginea include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce fever, and ease respiratory issues, making it a valuable natural remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Clethra ferruginea include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and therapeutic actions.
